description: The SEC filings behind a company's data. Without `accession`: every accession number the record cites across the financial statements, the 10-K/10-Q narrative and the 8-K events digest, newest first, each with its form (10-K, 10-Q, 8-K, 20-F, 6-K, DEF 14A...), filing date where stated, EDGAR index URL, document URL where known and every use (which periods' figures came from it, which narrative or events sections cite it); plus the annual and quarterly report the record is built from. With `accession` (dashes optional): everything about that one filing, including the full text of every narrative and events passage that cites it, e.g. what an 8-K announced; every published record is searched unless `record` is given. An accession number (0001045810-26-000075 = filer CIK 0001045810, year 2026, sequence 75) is the SEC's permanent ID for a filing, the thing to cite. For the sec.gov line behind one figure, use get_figure.

accession.description: One SEC accession number, e.g. 0001045810-26-000073. Omit to list them all.

record.description: An earlier published record, by tag ('FY27Q1') or by the period its filing reports ('Q1 FY2027'). Omit for the latest. list_periods lists every record.

ticker.description: Ticker symbol, case-insensitive. Examples: NVDA, brk-b, BRK.B.

name: get_filings
title: SEC filings and accession numbers
